children: Bulgaria’s industrial production fell 6.8% year-on-year in July 2026, deepening from a 2.5% decline in June.

Manufacturing output contracted (-7.3% vs 1.4% in June), driven mainly by declines in fabricated metal products, except machinery and equipment (-29.5%), leather and related products (-25.9%), other transport equipment (-23.3%), textiles (-14.3%), chemicals and chemical products (-11.2%), other non-metallic mineral products (-9.8%), and motor vehicles, trailers and semi-trailers (-9.7%).
Mining and quarrying activity also remained weak (-36.1% vs -49.0%).
In contrast, electricity, gas, steam and air conditioning supply advanced (16.7% vs 8.7%).
By main industrial grouping, output fell in investment goods (-9.1% vs 7.2%) and consumer durables (-7.4% vs 0.1%), while contraction deepened in intermediate goods (-11.3% vs -9.9%).
On a monthly basis, industrial production fell 3.0% in July from a 0.1% drop in June.

title: Bulgaria Industrial Production Falls to 5-Month Low
